Modon

An Abu Dhabi-based, ADX-listed holding company whose real estate arm is master-developing Hudayriyat Island alongside projects on Reem Island.

Profile

Modon Holding is a diversified group headquartered in Abu Dhabi and listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. It took its current name in 2024, when the listed Q Holding absorbed Modon Properties, ADNEC Group and related assets and rebranded as Modon. Its activities now span real estate, hospitality, events and tourism, asset and investment management, and urban infrastructure.

In residential property, Modon's most significant undertaking is Hudayriyat Island, where it is creating a series of waterfront and hillside neighbourhoods around public leisure facilities such as cycling and mountain-bike trails, beach areas and sports venues. The group is also active on Reem Island and elsewhere in the capital, and it operates or manages destinations including Al Mugheirah Bay, Marsana and the Bab Al Nojoum resorts, as well as projects outside the UAE. According to the company, its residential projects in investment zones such as Hudayriyat Island and Al Reem Island are offered on a freehold basis to buyers of all nationalities.

Key areas of activity

  • Hudayriyat Island master development
  • Residential communities on Reem Island
  • Hospitality and leisure destinations
  • Events, catering and tourism
  • Asset management and urban infrastructure
